in_marathi.name: Purandara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The City of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purandara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Purandara is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Purandar', which means 'the city of God'. It is also associated with Lord Shiva, who is known as Purandara.
